title.narrative: Integrated Approach to Building Community Resilience in Nasarawa State & Federal Capital Territory

description.narrative: The project will build on the successes of the novel LGA UHC approach implemented in Keffi LGA of Nasarawa State to consolidate the gains and extend the approach to two LGAs (Area Councils) in the FCT. The scope of the project will be expanded to include community case identification of malnutrition in children and linkage to treatment. The project will be implemented in 5 wards in Keffi Local Government Areas (LGAs) of Nasarawa State and 4 Wards each in Bwari and Gwagwalada Area Councils (ACs) of FCT. The project will entail (a) identification of malnutrition cases and referrals for treatment; (b) sensitization of caregivers of children with severe acute malnutrition (SAM) on nutrition best practices and the benefits of health insurance (c) support for the care givers of children with SAM to establish contributory platforms for gathering premium for health insurance uptake; (d) sensitization and mobilization of community members to increase health insurance uptake; (e) advocacy for the adoption of poor and vulnerable community members by religious and informal sector organizations and influential community members; (f) engagement of existing community contributory platforms such as Village Savings and Loan Association (VSLA), cooperative societies to advocate for the use of the platforms to collect premiums for their members; (g) creating and interface for the government agencies and service providers to discuss and resolve supply side issues; (h) building the capacity of FCT health insurance agency on resource mobilization; and (i) tracking the disbursement and utilization of Basic Health Care Provision Fund (BHCPF) using the citizen-led BHCPF accountability framework.
